question: In a certain code language, ‘PAIR’ is written as ‘ZKIR’ and ‘SAIL’ is written as ‘ZHOR’. How will ‘BULK’ be written in that language?
solution:
Here, the alphabets and their positions are shown as below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a72a30b8cfc6309b36506bcbabb6647d5379494fca9023856cca8a5a79bf064f.png] 

‘PAIR’ is written as ‘ZKIR’ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b4a82ea6d2cc101366f295813ec9b18586393cafd9c73cca9cb854ee7660ea2.png] 

And,

‘SAIL’ is written as ‘ZHOR’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2f53d27b58dadeeb54993dd5390c04ac3155cd073d0edebd04d5d502843e7c4.png] 

Similarly,

‘BULK’ be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0acf0484d1b511612473e33e851fb0967bf9ff39a2ec78a31524fe61c92edf50.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"FYPO".**
